<!-- pr-reviewer: cf3b6a57c1f0d1daa26b6bfb813dc05b93a46ae4 -->

Re-review of head cf3b6a57c. This review supersedes the review of ef93ed0b.

**Verdict: needs rework.** One blocker stands. The two blockers from the
last review are resolved.

## Previous blockers

1. Ribbon machine-mode law: Resolved. `MACHINE_MODES` now carries a
   `WireEdm` row ("Wire EDM", "Sodick ALC400G") with a short caption, and
   the Machine tip text in `tips_match_the_imgui_table` lists Wire EDM.
   The test `every_kind_with_a_shipped_machine_has_a_mode` passes.
2. Clippy `err_expect`: Resolved. `crates/app/tests/sodick_alc400g.rs`
   uses `expect_err`. Clippy is clean.

## Blocker at this head

1. `docs/decisions/1501-sodick-alc400g.md`, lines 44-48, still states the
   false mechanism. The paragraph says the post "refuses it too
   (\"states no wire plane\")". No such refusal exists in the code. A
   search over `crates/` and `assets/` finds no "wire plane" string. The
   paragraph also cites the test name
   `a_tapered_punch_is_refused_at_post_until_guide_heights_and_a_wire_plane_exist`.
   This head renamed that test to
   `a_tapered_punch_is_refused_at_post_while_the_file_states_no_guide_heights`.
   Fix: state the real mechanism in that paragraph. The app refuses a
   taper in `crates/app/src/machine/wire_edm.rs` when the file states no
   guide heights, when it states no `edm.max_taper_deg`, or when the lean
   passes the stated limit. The Sodick post refuses every taper, because
   it writes a vertical 2-axis cut only (`assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps`,
   the taper rule). The machine file, the test and the PR body now say
   this correctly. Only the decision file is left. It is the record
   #1800 builds on, so it must be true.

## Gate results

Built locally, in a review worktree. The branch already carries current
main (merge 759574223), so the trial merge is clean by ancestry.

- `camcraft-app`, test binary `sodick_alc400g`: 5 passed, 0 failed. The
  renamed taper pinning test passes.
- `camcraft-app`, test binary `machine`: 33 passed, 0 failed. The pinned
  machine list holds.
- `camcraft-ui --lib`: 814 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. The two ribbon
  tests above pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D
  warnings`: clean.

## Law checks

- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in added non-test source lines.
- The machine file follows `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`: a valid
  `wire_edm` kind, `edm.max_taper_deg` only, travels centred on zero, and
  a description that names one source per figure.
- The new test file carries its provenance line and Gate map. No
  CHANGELOG or snapshot PNG edits. The post script is exempt from the
  400-line rule; `posting.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` were
  already over the limit; this diff adds 3 lines to `posting.rs` and edits
  one tip string. Not blocking.
- The diff scope is the machine file, one `MACHINES` row in
  `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, the machine-mode table and its two test
  files, and the decision file. As the body claims.

This PR goes back to draft for the one decision-file fix. Push the
paragraph change, then flag it ready for a fresh review. The gate work
here stands: only the paragraph needs the push.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 90c0fa76cb1ef694192823ae178b12397e5911ee -->

**Verdict: clean. A collaborator can merge this head.**

This is the re-review of head 90c0fa76c. It adds one commit to the last reviewed head, cf3b6a57c. That commit changes only `docs/decisions/1501-sodick-alc400g.md`. The code is unchanged.

**Previous blocker: cleared.** The decision file no longer claims the post refuses with the text "states no wire plane". No such text exists in the tree. The file now names the real refusals, and each one agrees with the code:

- `crates/app/src/machine/wire_edm.rs` refuses a tapered cut while the file states no guide heights. The message names `edm.lower_guide_z` and `edm.upper_guide_z`.
- When a user adds the guide heights, the same code refuses a lean past `edm.max_taper_deg`. It also refuses an upper-guide offset outside the U or V stroke band.
- `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` writes a vertical 2-axis cut only, and refuses any taper by name.
- The test name `a_tapered_punch_is_refused_at_post_while_the_file_states_no_guide_heights` exists in `crates/app/tests/sodick_alc400g.rs`. The old test name appears nowhere in the tree.

I checked the rest of the decision file against the code. The machine file, its registration in `posting::MACHINES`, the centred travels, the `edm.max_taper_deg` value of 25, the condition refusal text, and both wire posts agree with its statements.

**What I ran.** Local build in a review worktree at this head, debug mode:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sodick_alc400g`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test machine`: 33 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 814 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.

**Law checks.**

- The new non-test code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()`. The source lines are the registry entry and the Wire EDM mode row.
- Provenance: the machine file states its public sources in its description. The decision file lists them with dates. No vendor or HSMWorks material is involved.
- The PR changes no `CHANGELOG.md` row and no snapshot PNG.
- The machine file follows `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`: a declared `kind` word, travels centred on zero, and unstated capabilities left absent, not guessed.
- A trial merge with current main (`origin/main` at afa037b77) is clean with `git merge-tree`.

Built and tested locally in the reviewer's worktree. The PR test runner was not used.
